integrity: The numerical minimum is supported by independently checkable integer primal and rational dual certificates; established torsion group and cycle construction are fully attributed to earlier work.
limitations: The sharp filling norm is for the 5-by-5 chessboard complex and symmetry-related induced octahedral generators; no asymptotic claim, global classification of fillings, or exhaustive bibliographic priority claim.
title: A sharp 68-tetrahedron filling of the minimal chessboard three-torsion sphere
